description: The course comprehensively explores advanced analytical techniques for detecting and investigating financial crimes. Students will gain expertise in anomaly detection, data preparation, descriptive and predictive analytics, and cutting-edge deep learning applications. The syllabus covers essential topics such as data visualization, Benford's Law, clustering algorithms, linear modeling, neural networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks. Advanced concepts like explainable AI, adversarial attacks and defenses, and graph analysis are also addressed. This course emphasizes practical applications, continuous monitoring, and analytics reporting in business environments, preparing students to tackle a wide range of financial crimes including fraud, money laundering, terror financing, market manipulation, and cyber intrusions. By combining theoretical foundations with hands-on experience, students will develop the technological and managerial skills necessary to lead in financial security and risk management roles, while also gaining insight into the challenges of implementing machine learning projects in real-world business scenarios.
